pr.title: Re-pin every layer to main for state:mount's Actions fix
pr.body:
In Actions, the site publish's `site:mount-board` step fails with `Duplicate header: "Authorization"` from `state:mount`. litlfred/cat-harness-tools#2464 (35bad4c2) fixes that.

This PR re-pins every layer to its current main, with `mount:remote --seed` and then `workflow-pins --write`:

| layer | from | to |
|---|---|---|
| folio-assistant-core | 7d175a59 | 419d5950 |
| cat-harness | d41ff7ce | 44f3c050 |
| cat-harness-tools | 372b9498 | 35bad4c2 |
| bootstrap | 7db84577 | 417192be |
| bootstrap-tools | 174a567d | 60e5ffc2 |

Both callers, `site-publish.yml` and `publish-context.yml`, now point at tools 35bad4c2.

Checks run locally, all passing:
- `lock:coherence:check`: OK, with 6 of 6 pairs agreeing and 5 of 5 pins fresh.
- `mount:remote:check`: exit 0. It still shows the existing unverified-approver warning, because the instance declares no `mountApprovers`.
- `site:check-library-jsonld`: exit 0.
